FROM THE
PRESIDENT
Dear Brothers,
At is with great pleasure and pride that this entire special
issue of the DIAMOND is devoted to a report of the
success ofthe 1987-88 Annual Giving program. And suc
cessful it was!
In a year of some economic uncertainty (who can forget
October 19, 1987?), 2,435 of Psi Upsilon's most loyal
alumni contributed a record $153,358 to the Annual Giv
ing program. Thanks to this unprecedented generosity,
the Fraternity was able to maintain its traditionally high
standards, broaden its undergraduate educational pro
grams, and enhance its services to chapters, while stUl
balancing its operating budget.
This enthusiastic response is truly heartwarming. The
Executive Council extends its warmest and most sincere
appreciation to every alumnus who participated in this
year's Annual Giving program for the strong show offaith
in Psi Upsilon's future. It is through such generous sup
port that we can continue to extend the warm hand of
brotherhood to yet another generation of undergradu
ates.
Yours in the bonds.
Wilham R. Robie, Epsilon Omega '66

This entire special issue of the DIAMOND is devoted to honoring the 2,435 donors
to the 1987-88 Annual Giving program. The photographs interspersed throughout the
issue depict some of the educational programs, conferences, and presentations that
have been made possible through these generous donations. Psi UpsUon is inordinately
proud to recognize its loyal and supportive alumni and extends to them its heartiest
appreciation.
PLEASE NOTE: The donors listed in this issue are those who contributed to the
Fraternity's Annual Giving program between July 1, 1987 and June 30, 1988. Gifts
received subsequent to June 30, 1988 have been credited to the 1988-89 program and
will appear in next year's special issue ofthe DIAMOND. Contributions made directly
to individual chapters or to the Psi Upsilon Foundation, although very gratefully
received, are not represented on the following pages.
